clips.sound: Pencil scribbles, eraser rub, a crisp approval stamp and a sensible verdict.
clips.sfx: A pencil scribbles in an increasingly fussy little loop, a soft rubber eraser rub, then one confident satisfying rubber stamp on paper. Warm tactile office foley, no voices, no music.

clips.title: Underground achievements
clips.heading: NOTHING HAPPENING?
clips.when: A quiet patch of soil reveals a busy root system before one leaf appears.
clips.sound: Earth crumbles, soft branching crackles, a sprout pluck and a wry observation.
clips.sfx: Soft close-up earth crumbling, several delicate branching woody crackles spreading underneath, then a tiny bright organic sprout pop. Intimate miniature nature foley, no voices, no music.

clips.title: Feedback received
clips.heading: INNER CRITIC: LIVE
clips.setup: thank you for the unsolicited noise.
clips.when: A peaceful frog sends an intrusive megaphone away and presses mute.
clips.sound: A comically nasal kazoo blurt, switch click, a soft airy release and a calm response.
clips.sfx: A very short annoying nasal kazoo-like blurt, a clean mute switch click cuts it off, followed by a gentle soft airy exhale. Funny but soothing foley, no speech, no words, no music.

clips.title: Asynchronous by nature
clips.heading: SEEN. PROCESSING.
clips.when: A stack of messages becomes a letter in a bottle and floats away on a gentle tide.
clips.sound: Inbox ticks, paper folding, a glass clink, cork pop and gentle water.
clips.sfx: Three small inbox ticks, crisp paper folds, a tiny glass bottle clinks and a cork softly pops into place, a gentle water plop. Miniature whimsical foley, no voices, no music.

clips.title: Different clocks
clips.heading: THE COMPARISON GAME
clips.setup: their timeline is not your timer.
clips.when: Two clocks run at different speeds, then receive the same little gold star.
clips.sound: Two contrasting clock ticks settle into a shared soft chime and a reassuring line.
clips.sfx: Two small clocks tick at different speeds, one quick and one slow, then both stop gently and two equal warm glass chimes ring together. Quiet tactile foley, no voices, no music.

clips.title: An unplanned view
clips.heading: SO MUCH FOR THE PLAN
clips.when: A rejected plan folds into a little boat and sails toward a warm sunrise.
clips.sound: Paper crumple and folds, a soft splash, a bright reveal and a contented conclusion.
clips.sfx: A sheet of paper crumples briefly then crisply folds into a boat, a soft small splash, gentle rippling water and a delicate warm glass sparkle. Storybook foley, no speech, no voices, no music.

meme_reflections.sound_provenance: ElevenLabs generated voice and effects, with original timed accents. Offline cached playback.

pocket_postcards.title: Pocket postcards

clips.title: Pocket sunshine
clips.heading: POCKET SUNSHINE
clips.when: A little jar of sunshine, saved for the days that need it.
clips.sound: A glass ping, a tiny lid pop, and a warm rising sun-chime.

clips.title: A cup of sorry
clips.heading: A PEACE OFFERING
clips.when: One apology, served warm. The tiny white flag is included.
clips.sound: A gentle ceramic clink, a flag flutter, and a warm tea-kettle coo.

clips.title: Slow progress club
clips.heading: SLOW PROGRESS CLUB
clips.when: A very determined snail celebrates a very small distance.
clips.sound: Soft little travel squeaks and a miniature victory fanfare.

clips.title: Priority heart mail
clips.heading: PRIORITY DELIVERY
clips.when: An envelope carrying something rather bigger than a letter.
clips.sound: Paper flutter, a soft seal pop, and a heart-sized three-note sparkle.

clips.title: Return to sender
clips.heading: SEND IT BACK.
clips.when: Unnecessary guilt has been declined by the receiving department.
clips.sound: Paper shuffles, one satisfyingly soft stamp, and a relieved little flourish.

clips.title: A softer landing
clips.heading: SOFT LANDING
clips.when: A paper plane misses the plan and finds a pillow. A perfectly valid landing.
clips.sound: A paper-flight whistle, a plush poof, a tiny bounce and a reassuring bell.

pocket_postcards.sound_provenance: Original deterministic synthesis. No voices, music recordings or third-party samples.

seasonal_encore.title: A few more reasons to smile

clips.title: Two hearts, one click
clips.heading: VALENTINE'S DAY
clips.when: A Valentine greeting: two folded paper hearts take a shy orbit, then meet with a little click.
clips.sound: Two shy paper plucks, an airy orbit, a soft clasp click, and a warm original chord.

clips.title: Good fortune, tucked inside
clips.heading: LUNAR NEW YEAR
clips.when: A red-packet-inspired Lunar New Year greeting: an original gold paper flourish springs up, followed by a little tangerine.
clips.sound: A paper packet rustle, a springy original pluck, a little tangerine landing, and a bright gentle flourish.

clips.title: A very extra entrance
clips.heading: CARNIVAL
clips.when: A Carnival greeting: a paper mask shimmies its feathers and ribbons, then takes a confetti bow.
clips.sound: Soft ribbon swishes, two playful original plucks, a little bow beat, and scattered confetti ticks.

clips.title: Three leaves, one soft landing
clips.heading: ST PATRICK'S DAY
clips.when: A St Patrick's Day greeting: a green felt hat catches a folded three-leaf shamrock, which opens over its brim.
clips.sound: An airy leaf whistle, a soft felt catch, a paper unfolding rustle, and a small original lucky pluck.

clips.title: A little care for Earth
clips.heading: EARTH DAY
clips.when: A little Earth globe receives a leafy mend and grows a hopeful new sprout.
clips.sound: A gentle globe creak, leafy paper rustle, two mending plucks and a warm growing chord.

clips.title: The strawberry heist
clips.heading: SUMMER PICNIC
clips.when: Three determined ants carry one extremely ambitious strawberry off the picnic cloth.
clips.sound: Three light ant footsteps, a tiny lifting strain, a soft marching rhythm and a strawberry-sized flourish.

clips.title: The bonus mushroom
clips.heading: AUTUMN HARVEST
clips.when: A woven basket catches two small mushrooms, then one very generous bonus mushroom.
clips.sound: Two soft mushroom plops, a falling whoosh, a squashy basket thump and a contented harvest chord.

clips.title: A little more daylight
clips.heading: WINTER SOLSTICE
clips.when: The long night parts like a paper curtain and a little sun rises over snowy hills.
clips.sound: A quiet night hum, two soft curtain swishes, a rising sunrise motif and a warm daylight chord.

clips.title: A questionable little sprout
clips.heading: APRIL FOOLS!
clips.when: A terracotta flowerpot grows a rubber duck on a spring. The gardening manual is unavailable.
clips.sound: A little soil rustle, a springy pluck, a soft duck-toy pop and a warm surprise chord.

clips.title: A little pretzel party
clips.heading: OKTOBERFEST!
clips.when: Two warm pretzels bounce in, share a cheerful little toast, then take one last dance step.
clips.sound: Two soft bakery landings, a bright little toast, and a pair of playful dance plucks.

clips.title: A little light, shared
clips.heading: HAPPY DIWALI
clips.when: A small clay oil lamp lights while an original geometric petal rangoli blooms softly around it.
clips.sound: A gentle wick chime, soft petal plucks, and a warm universal three-note chord.

clips.title: So much little light
clips.heading: HAPPY HANUKKAH
clips.when: A raised central shamash shares its light with eight candles in a straight row, from left to right.
clips.sound: A warm helper-light chime, eight individual lighting plucks, and a soft final chord.

seasonal_encore.sound_provenance: Original deterministic nonverbal synthesis; no voices, recordings or sampled songs.

seasonal_postcards.title: A year of little moments
seasonal_postcards.advent_days: December 1–24; every day can be previewed at any time.

clips.title: A wish with sprinkles
clips.heading: HAPPY BIRTHDAY!
clips.when: A birthday wish gets a slightly excessive helping of confetti.
clips.sound: A candle twinkle, a soft puff, and a playful confetti flourish.

clips.title: A sweet Christmas surprise
clips.heading: MERRY CHRISTMAS
clips.when: A gingerbread cookie springs out of its gift and offers a tiny heart.
clips.sound: Ribbon rustle, a gift lid pop, and warm gingerbread bells.

clips.title: A very polite boo
clips.heading: HAPPY HALLOWEEN
clips.when: A tiny ghost borrows the pumpkin hat and leaves a candy thank-you.
clips.sound: A soft ghost whoosh, a hat pop, and a candy chime.

clips.title: An egg-stra small surprise
clips.heading: HAPPY EASTER
clips.when: A decorated egg cracks open and grows an unexpectedly proud carrot.
clips.sound: A delicate egg tap, a tiny shell pop, and a cheerful sprout chime.

clips.title: Shade for a sweet day
clips.heading: HELLO, SUMMER
clips.when: A melting ice cream receives its own miniature beach umbrella.
clips.sound: A sunny chime, a tiny melting plop, and an umbrella pop.

clips.title: The leaf blanket service
clips.heading: HELLO, AUTUMN
clips.when: A sleepy hedgehog catches a falling leaf and calls it a blanket.
clips.sound: A papery leaf rustle, a tiny landing, and a sleepy warm chime.

clips.title: A scarf-sized hug
clips.heading: HELLO, WINTER
clips.when: A snowman pulls its scarf right up to its nose and enjoys the snow.
clips.sound: Soft snowfall sparkle, a woolly rustle, and a cozy little bell.

clips.title: Just add a little kindness
clips.heading: HELLO, SPRING
clips.when: A tiny watering can gives bare stems the confidence to bloom.
clips.sound: Gentle water drops and three flowers blooming as a rising chime.

clips.title: A pocket-sized fresh start
clips.heading: HAPPY NEW YEAR!
clips.when: A party popper launches a constellation of hopeful little stars.
clips.sound: Three bright countdown ticks, a soft pop, and a starry chime.

clips.title: First little light
clips.heading: ADVENT 01
clips.when: December 1: a tiny calendar door opens and lets the first star out.
clips.sound: A little latch tick, a paper hinge, a golden ping, and a warm three-note chord.

clips.title: Spark duty
clips.heading: ADVENT 02
clips.when: December 2: one wandering spark finds a candle wick and gets to work.
clips.sound: A soft falling whistle, a little ignition pop, and a warm candle hum.

clips.title: Wrapped in warmth
clips.heading: ADVENT 03
clips.when: December 3: a shivering present gets a very long scarf and settles down.
clips.sound: Two tiny shiver ticks, soft wool swishes, and a warm finishing chime.

clips.title: Branch delivery
clips.heading: ADVENT 04
clips.when: December 4: a bauble bounces into view and hooks itself onto a fir branch.
clips.sound: Two round little bounces, a hook tick, and a glassy ornament bell.

clips.title: Folded wishes
clips.heading: ADVENT 05
clips.when: December 5: a written wish folds itself into an envelope and receives a heart seal.
clips.sound: Paper folds, a seal pop, then a tiny delivery flourish.

clips.title: Boot bonus
clips.heading: ADVENT 06
clips.when: December 6: a waiting Saint Nicholas boot catches a clementine, a sweet, and a star.
clips.sound: Three little gift plops followed by a soft celebratory jingle.

clips.title: Icing on the day
clips.heading: ADVENT 07
clips.when: December 7: a plain gingerbread star gets a piped icing border and one sugar heart.
clips.sound: A soft piping swish, six delicate sugar ticks, and a sweet final ping.

clips.title: One tiny snowflake
clips.heading: ADVENT 08
clips.when: December 8: a woolly mitten follows a drifting snowflake and catches it gently.
clips.sound: An airy falling chime, a soft wool catch, and a crystalline sparkle.

clips.title: Cocoa express
clips.heading: ADVENT 09
clips.when: December 9: a toy train pulls in with a very important cargo of hot chocolate.
clips.sound: Three tiny wheel beats, a warm toy whistle, and a ceramic arrival clink.

clips.title: Fold by fold
clips.heading: ADVENT 10
clips.when: December 10: a folded paper wedge opens into a six-armed snowflake.
clips.sound: Three papery unfolding swishes and a bright reveal chime.

clips.title: Peel the magic
clips.heading: ADVENT 11
clips.when: December 11: a clementine unwinds a curly peel ribbon that finishes in a star.
clips.sound: A delicate peel rustle, a curling slide, and a sunny star ping.

clips.title: Cheers to small joys
clips.heading: ADVENT 12
clips.when: December 12: two cocoa mugs slide together, toast, and share a heart of steam.
clips.sound: Two gentle mug slides, one ceramic toast, and a rising warm heart chord.

clips.title: The biscuit bedtime
clips.heading: ADVENT 13
clips.when: A sleepy gingerbread biscuit finds a matchbox bed and gets tucked in.
clips.sound: A sliding matchbox, a soft pillow landing, a blanket rustle and a sleepy two-note hum.

clips.title: The penguin pirouette
clips.heading: ADVENT 14
clips.when: One tiny penguin turns a careful skate into an unexpectedly graceful spin.
clips.sound: A soft skating swish, a rising spin chime and a pleased little ice bell.

clips.title: The helpful ribbon
clips.heading: ADVENT 15
clips.when: A rather independent ribbon wraps its own present and ties a generous bow.
clips.sound: A silky ribbon rustle, two soft loop pops and a golden knot chime.

clips.title: A little world settles
clips.heading: ADVENT 16
clips.when: A snow globe shakes out its worries, then watches every last snowflake settle.
clips.sound: A glass tick, a gentle snow shuffle and a calm descending glass chime.

clips.title: The paper tree encore
clips.heading: ADVENT 17
clips.when: A hand-cranked music box gives its paper tree a very small stage.
clips.sound: Crank ticks, an original four-note music-box phrase, and a final warm bell.

clips.title: A lantern for a star
clips.heading: ADVENT 18
clips.when: A wandering star finds the open door of a lantern and makes itself at home.
clips.sound: A wandering star whistle, a lantern-door tick and a warm sparkling welcome.

clips.title: Pinecone party dress
clips.heading: ADVENT 19
clips.when: A little pinecone receives a slightly oversized party hat. It is delighted.
clips.sound: A falling felt swish, one soft hat plop and a happy three-note jingle.

clips.title: A heart with a sled
clips.heading: ADVENT 20
clips.when: A tiny wooden sled somehow delivers a heart much larger than its cargo space.
clips.sound: A wooden snow glide, a soft braking bump and a generous heart chime.

clips.title: Reindeer snack break
clips.heading: ADVENT 21
clips.when: A tiny reindeer drops its carrot, retrieves it, and declares a snack break.
clips.sound: A carrot tumble, a soft snowy plop, a happy nibble and a satisfied little hum.

clips.title: Socks by the fireside
clips.heading: ADVENT 22
clips.when: Two hanging socks sway into place above a small glowing fireplace.
clips.sound: Two cloth swishes, tiny warm fire ticks, and a soft rising hearth hum.

clips.title: The moon does tuck-in
clips.heading: ADVENT 23
clips.when: The moon pulls a cloud blanket over a sleepy snowy village and turns down the stars.
clips.sound: A soft night breeze, three window-light ticks and a sleepy descending lullaby chime.

clips.title: The Christmas Eve theatre
clips.heading: ADVENT 24
clips.when: Paper theatre curtains open to a tree whose lights spread all the way to the audience.
clips.sound: Velvet curtain rustles, an original rising light melody and a warm Christmas Eve chord.
